text:
sara_custsuccess: FYI — OrionHealth just pinged support about a weird dedicated capacity overage on the March invoice. They say they had a 4-node reserved commit but ~8 nodes were billed as burst on 03/09-03/11. Can we check before I escalate? :eyes:

alex_fin: Thanks Sara. Can you paste the invoice line items and the customer's committed pool ID? I can start a quick reconciliation.

sara_custsuccess: Invoice INV-2026-0311 attached in support ticket. Committed pool tag: oh-reserved-4. Ticket link: https://support.redwood/12345

billing-bot: Automated meter summary for OrionHealth (org: orion-123)
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0311
Period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31
Line items:
 - Reserved capacity (oh-reserved-4): 4 nodes - $8,000
 - Burst usage (burst-unallocated): 4 node-days - $1,200
 - Data egress / other: $160
Total: $9,360
```

lina_revops: Noted. If reserved pool was available but usage was misattributed, we should consider a retroactive adjustment + possible SLA credit if they experienced degraded throughput. Need metering receipts + node labels to confirm.

jordan_engineering: I pulled the node allocation logs for 03/09-03/11. There's a label mismatch: agents on us-west-2 had tag "oh-reserve-4" (missing the plural 's') at registration time. Autoscaler created ephemeral nodes with tag "oh-reserved-4" later, which our billing joiner treats as separate pool -> billed as burst. Looks like a cluster bootstrap script typo in the older agent version.

devon_ops: Ugh, that aligns with the agent rollout we did on 2026-03-08. We pushed a config that renamed the tag in some environments. I'll patch the bootstrap to accept both aliases and run a backfill to retag historical events where safe.

alex_fin: Good catch Jordan. For reconciliation: can you provide a short CSV of node_id, timestamp, tag_seen, and meter_id for the 03/09-03/11 window? We need that to justify adjusting the invoice. Also estimate the $ value to credit.

jordan_engineering: CSV ready, attaching here (exports: node_tag_mismatch_03_09_11.csv). Summary: 96 node-hours attributed to burst but belong to reserved pool -> estimated bill delta $1,050.

marie_sales: If we issue a credit, let's do a customer-facing note explaining root cause and remediation. Also consider a one-time goodwill SLA credit because they reported increased latency for 8 hours on 03/10. Devs confirmed degraded throughput during the tag mismatch window?

devon_ops: We saw degraded batching on 03/10 between 02:00-10:00 UTC due to transient autoscale churn. Logs show increased p90 latency by ~120ms. We'll include the timeline and mitigations in the note.

lina_revops: Finance: what's the approved ceiling for this sort of credit without VP sign-off? The raw billing delta is ~$1k but with SLA goodwill it could be ~$3k.

alex_fin: Policy: up to $2,500 can be approved by Finance manager for operational/metering errors. Anything above needs VP review. I can approve up to $2,500. Please prepare amounts: (1) invoice adjustment = $1,050, (2) SLA goodwill credit proposal = $2,000.

marie_sales: OK from Sales side for the customer relationship — we support the $2,000 goodwill credit. We'll present it as a one-off corrective credit tied to the tag issue + mitigation.

sara_custsuccess: I'll draft the customer message: short summary, timeline, credits to be applied (invoice adjustment $1,050 + goodwill SLA credit $2,000 = $3,050 total), and steps we took to prevent recurrence. Will ping legal if wording needs it.

alex_fin: Finance follow-up: once credits are final, issue a credit memo for $1,050 to adjust INV-2026-0311 and a separate credit memo for $2,000 as service credit. Use internal reason codes: METERING_TAG_MISMATCH & GOODWILL_SLA_CREDIT. Notify accounting to post the credits in March ledger.

devon_ops: Patch is deployed to the bootstrap. Backfill job scheduled, will attempt safe re-tagging for events older than 30 days only after approval. For this customer window it's within range so OK.

lina_revops: Please attach the CSV and the backfill run id to the revenue ops ticket so we have traceability for audits.

alex_fin: Lina — when you get the CSV and backfill id, I'll create the credit memos and route to AP for posting. Confirm with me before sending the customer-facing email.

sara_custsuccess: Draft ready, posting to thread as public reply to customer after Alex confirms the credit memos. Draft snippet: "We identified a tagging mismatch that caused 96 node-hours to be billed as burst instead of your reserved pool. We're issuing a $1,050 invoice correction and a $2,000 service credit for the disruption. We fixed the bootstrap and backfilled the records. Apologies for the inconvenience."

alex_fin: Approved. Go ahead after I upload the credit memos (will do within 2 hours).

billing-bot: Credit memos created: CM-2026-047 (INV adj $1,050), CM-2026-048 (Service credit $2,000). Queueing for posting.

lina_revops: Recording: revenue ops ticket revops-789 attaches node_tag_mismatch_03_09_11.csv and backfill job id bf-2026-332. Audit trail confirmed.

sara_custsuccess: Sent to customer with the note + links to remediation docs. Customer replied: "Thanks — appreciate the quick fix and the transparency. Will confirm once credits reflect." :slightly_smiling_face:

alex_fin: Closing loop: AP posted credits to March ledger. Finance marks as complete. Thanks team. :tada:
